Your holiday protection

ATOL protection for flight-inclusive package holidays

Flight-inclusive holidays are financially protected by the ATOL scheme.

What this means for you

You receive an ATOL certificate.

Check that flights, hotels, and services are listed.

If a trip part is not listed, that part is not ATOL protected.

Financial Protection for different types of bookings

Flight Only bookings:

Some flights have ATOL protection, but not all.

We show protection before you complete your booking.

No ATOL certificate means the flight booking is not ATOL protected.

Non-flight Package Holidays:

Non-flight package holidays are protected through ABTA bonding.

ABTA protection does not apply to standalone services.

More Information:

See our booking conditions for details.

Visit the Civil Aviation Authority website for ATOL certificate information.
